extrinsics_source: Explicit simulated design: lateral sensor beside native G1, optical axis tilted toward grasp region. Fixed USD child of link7; not independently moved.
housing_limitation: Optical sensor only. No mass/collider change to frozen robot. Physical camera housing/cable/mount clearance remains unvalidated.
survey_dependency: Known closed cabinet coarse collision envelope and registered station; no handle vertex, grasp pose or scene-camera image/depth. Subsequent views use current wrist-observed points and panel normal.
